qa_pair.question: Among alerts created in July 2026 with priority P1, which one has the highest deduplication count? Give its tinyId.
Find the oldest alert that is currently still open and unacknowledged. How many days has it been open, rounded down?
How many on-call schedules exist on the site, and how many of them are disabled? Answer as "total/disabled".
For the alert with the highest deduplication count in July 2026, who wrote the first note on its timeline?
Which integration is the source of the largest number of open alerts? Give the integration name.
Take the schedule whose name contains "platform". Which timezone is it configured in?
For the most recent P1 alert closed in July 2026, how many minutes elapsed between its creation and its acknowledgement? Round to the nearest minute.
Among alerts tagged with the most common tag on the site, what fraction were acknowledged before being closed? Answer as a percentage rounded to the nearest whole number.
Look at the activity log of the longest-open unacknowledged alert. How many distinct escalation steps fired before it was left unhandled?
For a specific past incident window (fix an exact UTC timestamp in July 2026 when a P1 fired), who was on-call on the owning team's schedule at that moment?
